text:
Aisha Khan: kicking off bring-up for pavo13b-int4 via adapter-shim path from Mistral -> Gemma.
Aisha Khan: early smoke shows decode divergence after ~64 tokens, not immediate crash.
Jordan Lee: can you paste the attention tensor shape/dtype and the KV header bytes?
Aisha Khan: sure, gist:
```
attn qkv shape: (12, 64, 64)
head_dim: 64
dtype: int8 packed
kv header hex: 0x6d5f0012
```
Marta Chen: that kv header looks like our old little-endian tag; we saw a head-order swap in the export for pavo variants.
Samir Patel: try toggling ATTENTION_HEAD_ORDER=reverse in runtime, run a short uni test.
devops-bot: canary env spun up: canary-42 (pavo13b-int4) started in us-west-2.
build-bot: ci/quant-smoke failed on serialization test 3/12: mismatch checksum.
Aisha Khan: quick test with head-order reverse -> logits align on first 96 tokens, but long-ctx resume still diverges when restoring KV cache.
Jordan Lee: could be token id sentinel remap on pad/cls. We had a similar failure where tokenizer used nfkc normalization and gemma exporter didn't map sentinel.
Marta Chen: also check per-head scaling: Gemma patches require scaling factor / sqrt(head_dim) applied differently on export.
Samir Patel: command to run locally:
```
python tools/convert_adapter.py --in pavo13b.mistral.bin --out pavo13b.gemma.bin --remap head-swap --fix-endian
```
Aisha Khan: running above now, uploading logs to s3://redwood-test/pavo13b/1760004321/logs.tar.gz
Jordan Lee: if that fixes it, add a unit test to net/kv_serialize_test referencing the header hex and head-order flag.
Marta Chen: pinging @eng-ml-rotary for visibility :eyes:
Aisha Khan: thanks — I'll run a 2-hour canary and post perf+eval diffs.
Samir Patel: also please include a minimal repro snippet for the decoder-only loop so we can add to nightly regression harness.
Aisha Khan: will attach repro and follow up in this thread. :white_check_mark:
